name: tmessaoudi-official/twes-in-api
description: twes-in REST API — invoicing and billing. Clean-room reimplementation, no upstream code.

scripts-descriptions.gate: Run the API tier's full quality gate. Green means every step, not most of them.
scripts-descriptions.gate:architecture: Hexagonal fitness: no ORM attributes, no outward or vendor dependencies, and no ambient clock/randomness/environment/IO in Domain/; SPDX headers present; locale keys in parity. Runs on plain PHP so it needs no installed dependencies. Also runs shell-syntax.sh: bash -n over every tracked script INCLUDING the other gates, because a syntax error in a gate makes it stop detecting while its non-zero exit reads as a detection. And no-orphaned-docblocks.php, because a doc comment's POSITION is part of its truth and three successive certification rounds filed a stranded one -- the third created by the second's own fix. It is a token_get_all() pass rather than a line-pattern one because round 18 showed a positional rule enforced only ONE spelling of the rule and missed four of five genuine shapes, a blank line between the two blocks among them. And no-owner-connection-in-application.php: config/packages/doctrine.yaml calls the default/owner connection split a security boundary, and round 21 showed the container hands the owner connection to any caller that asks — #[Target('owner')] or getConnection('owner') is one line from a role that can DROP POLICY, which FORCE does not prevent.
scripts-descriptions.gate:schema: Assert every tenant-owned table in a REAL MIGRATED SCHEMA is RLS-enabled, FORCED, canonically policed, NOT NULL on the tenant column, and beyond the runtime role's ownership and TRUNCATE. The ONLY gate here that needs a database -- a schema cannot be read from source, and an unpoliced tenant table is invisible to every check that can. Needs TWES_SCHEMA_DSN + TWES_SCHEMA_USER, or falls back to the integration suite's TWES_TEST_DSN pair. FAILS rather than skipping when it cannot connect.
scripts-descriptions.gate:licences: Fail if any dependency's licence is not on the permissive allowlist (LICENSING.md). NEEDS a populated pub cache: run `cd mobile && flutter pub get` first, or set PUB_CACHE.
scripts-descriptions.gate:mapping: Validate the service container and the Doctrine mapping without touching a database.
scripts-descriptions.gate:static: PHPStan at max level, including the banned-ambient-function rule for Domain/. THE ONE STEP THAT STILL FAILS: phpstan/phpstan is the only entry in composer.lock with no `source` URL, so --prefer-source cannot route around the 403 on api.github.com, and --no-dev is therefore required to install anything at all.
scripts-descriptions.gate:style: Check coding style without modifying files. Runs the PHAR in tools/bin/, NOT vendor/bin/: because --no-dev is required (see gate:static), no dev-dependency binary is ever installed, so `vendor/bin/php-cs-fixer` was error 127 and this step failed for every checkout while the tier was documented green.
scripts-descriptions.gate:test: Run every PHPUnit suite: unit, integration, functional, e2e. Runs the PHAR in tools/bin/ for the same reason as gate:style. Get both with `bash scripts/dev/fetch-tools.sh`, which verifies them against pinned SHA-256.
